source.name: GlobeNewswire: Meridianbet (GMGI) Extends Title Sponsorship with EuroLeague's Crvena Zvezda Through 2030
source.quote: with Meridianbet branding prominently featured on team jerseys and throughout Belgrade Arena home matches
source.note: Title sponsor since January 2023, extended through 2030; the 'meridian' wordmark sits on the front of the home shirt below the number. The 2024 emblem-integration deal put the Meridianbet logo into the club crest.

source.name: KK Crvena zvezda: Prvi dres KK Crvena zvezda za sezonu 2026-2027 (official home-kit launch)
source.quote: Ove godine prva garnitura dresova, uključujući i šorts, biće u dominantno crvenoj boji, sa zlatnim detaljima.
source.note: The 'mts' wordmark (Telekom Srbija's brand) sits on the front below 'meridian' in the article's official kit photos. No separate mts sponsorship announcement found (searched 2026-10-01).

source.name: KK Crvena zvezda: Prvi dres KK Crvena zvezda za sezonu 2026-2027 (official home-kit launch)
source.quote: Košarkaši Crvene zvezde i u novoj takmičarskoj 2026-2027 neće odstupiti od tradicije – kao prvu garnituru i prvi dres nosiće crveno belu kombinaciju
source.note: The 'W.D. Concord West Belgrade' logo sits on the upper right chest (below the adidas mark) in the article's official kit photos.

source.name: KK Crvena zvezda: Prvi dres KK Crvena zvezda za sezonu 2026-2027 (official home-kit launch)
source.quote: odlučili smo se da po prvi put u poslednjih 20-ak godina predstavimo dres koji i na leđima ima prepoznatljive pruge Crvene zvezde
source.note: The 'ALTA BANKA' logo sits below the back number in the article's official kit photos. ALTA banka's own channels (Instagram @altabanka, 24 Sep 2026) say the partnership with KK Crvena zvezda continues this season; the bank's site first announced the sponsorship in August 2024.

source.name: KK Crvena zvezda: Prvi dres KK Crvena zvezda za sezonu 2026-2027 (official home-kit launch)
source.note: Technical sponsor/kit manufacturer (sixth consecutive season with the club, per the launch article); adidas marks on the chest and shorts.
